description: A checkbox that records consent to a versioned document, with a link to read it.

props.name: documentVersion
props.description: The version of the document the consent covers.

props.name: linkLabel
props.description: The text of the link that opens the document.

events.name: onChanged
events.description: Fires with the new value when the person toggles the checkbox.

events.name: onAccepted
events.description: Fires with `documentVersion` when consent is given, so the page records the accepted version.

events.name: onLinkTap
events.description: Fires when the person taps the link.
